name: One Witch Hunter Edict per caster on each recipient (#3928, #3756)
contract: Knight's Edict 523485 and Greater Knight's Edict 523510 are separate spells that both apply armor (aura 22) and all primary attributes (aura 29), and no spell_group listed them, so Aura::CanStackWith let them coexist. The reports say a Witch Hunter can give a target only one of the Edicts (#3756: 'used to be 1 buff per Witch Hunter'), so they share spell group 1138 with stack rule 2 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER, Aura::CanStackWith, SpellAuras.cpp): a new Edict from the same caster replaces the old one, while a second Witch Hunter's Edict still coexists. The rule choice (2, not 1) is the maintainer decision recorded with the fix. Both spells have no stance, cost or reagent in Spell.dbc (2026-09-17); Greater is TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_PARTY, so it lands on the caster alone.

steps.label: Greater Knight's Edict from the same caster
It replaced the same caster's Knight's Edict
A second Witch Hunter gives Knight's Edict
The other caster's Knight's Edict coexists (rule 2, not rule 1)
The first caster's Greater Knight's Edict is kept
